mapper.select: SELECT FLOOR(CAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, #{q.start}, t.created_at) AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / #{q.bucketMinutes}) AS slot, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completed, COUNT(CASE WHEN THEN 1 END) AS measured, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'TIMEOUT' THEN 1 END) AS timedOut, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 END) AS processing, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) AS cancelled, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED' THEN 1 END) AS clarification, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN ELSE 0 END) AS durationSum, COUNT(CASE WHEN AND > #{q.targetSeconds} THEN 1 END) AS slow FROM query_task t WHERE GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot
SELECT AVG() FROM query_task t WHERE AND
mapper.sql: f.task_id = t.task_id AND f.user_id = t.user_id AND f.datasource_id = t.datasource_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible, COUNT(CASE WHEN f.feedback_type = 'LIKE' THEN 1 END) AS likes, COUNT(CASE WHEN f.feedback_type = 'DISLIKE' THEN 1 END) AS dislikes FROM query_task t LEFT JOIN governance_feedback f ON WHERE AND t.status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.datasource_id AS datasourceId, t.created_at AS createdAt, AS seconds, NULL AS reasonCode, NULL AS comment FROM query_task t WHERE AND AND > #{q.targetSeconds} ORDER BY seconds DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.datasource_id AS datasourceId, t.created_at AS createdAt, NULL AS seconds, f.reason_code AS reasonCode, f.comment AS comment FROM query_task t JOIN governance_feedback f ON WHERE AND t.status = 'COMPLETED' AND f.feedback_type = 'DISLIKE' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC
